info.name: Gojiberry AI - External AppExternal User API

items.docs: Retrieve the profile of the authenticated user. When impersonating with the x-impersonate-user-id header, the impersonated user is returned.

info.name: Get the permissions of the authenticated user

items.docs: Retrieve the organization permissions of the authenticated user. When impersonating with the x-impersonate-user-id header, the impersonated user permissions are returned.
